description: The dispatcher's safety tick (DEP9): the longest the infrastructure service waits between two passes when no notification wakes it (work freed, a run started). It is a failure timeout, not a trigger: the passes are woken by LISTEN/NOTIFY (migration 0006). Read at runtime from work.config_value, the compiled default when no row exists; PUT /v1/config/service.dispatch_s changes it within about a second, without a deploy.
